workflows.name: Commerce and creator ads
workflows.output_zh: 商品演示、广告开场；适合电商运营、达人和小商家。
workflows.output: Product demonstrations and ad openings for sellers and creators.
workflows.reason_zh: 先完成一个产品揭示镜头，再考虑人物反应和口播。
workflows.reason: Begin with one product reveal before adding creator reactions or speech.
support: 生成一个过渡镜头，随后在剪辑软件拼接
Generate one transition shot; assemble it in an editor
pickup: 缺产品揭示镜头时选用
Use when a product reveal is missing
Use when a reaction shot is missing
服装广告缺布料运动镜头时选用
Use for missing fabric-motion shots in apparel ads
workflows.steps_zh: 先写一个产品动作 → 用 UGC Maker 试拍并检查 → 在同一工具完成必要镜头 → 剪辑；只在缺镜头时补拍。
workflows.steps: Write one product action → trial it in UGC Maker and inspect → make the needed shots there → edit; add another tool only for a missing shot.
workflows.inputs_zh: 先用下方虚构茶瓶试拍；换成自己的商品时，写清形状、颜色和一个要展示的细节。
workflows.inputs: Try the fictional tea bottle below first. For your own product, specify its shape, color and one detail to reveal.
workflows.review_zh: 检查瓶身和瓶盖是否变形、光线是否连续、上方是否留下放文案的空间。
workflows.review: Check bottle and cap geometry, continuous light and usable copy space above.
workflows.tags_zh: 电商 · 产品揭示 · 文案留白
workflows.lesson_zh: 源配方把星光、水滴和天光变化组成一支茶饮广告。免费试拍只取“光线扫过瓶身”：保留产品轮廓与文案留白，先做一个能接进广告的产品镜头。
workflows.lesson: The source tea ad combines starlight, condensation and dawn. Keep only light passing across the bottle for the free trial: preserve its silhouette and space for copy to make one product shot for the edit.
workflows.next_zh: 先用观测站环境开场，接瓶身光线镜头，再停在产品主画面上加一句卖点。三段沿用同一瓶子和蓝调光线；精确标签与广告文字后期添加。
workflows.next: Open on the observatory, cut to light crossing the bottle, then hold on the product and add one selling point. Reuse its shape and blue-hour lighting; add exact labels and ad copy in editing.
workflows.fix_zh: 把观测站改为空白背景，其他条件先不动；瓶形稳定后再恢复环境。
workflows.fix: Replace the observatory with a plain background, leaving other instructions unchanged. Restore the setting after bottle geometry holds.
workflows.homepage_prompt_zh:
生成一个 5 秒的 16:9 产品镜头。
观测站桌面上，一只修长烟色玻璃茶瓶有深绿色瓶盖和空白浅色标签。
固定中景，只有一条窄光缓慢扫过静止瓶身，最后一秒停留。
瓶身、瓶盖和标签形状不变，上方留出文案空白。
轻微远处风声，不生成文字、对白或额外动作。
workflows.homepage_prompt:
Create one five-second product shot, 16:9.
A tall smoked-glass tea bottle with a dark green cap and blank pale label stands on an observatory desk.
Fixed medium shot: only a narrow band of light crosses the still bottle. Hold the last second.
Keep bottle, cap and label geometry fixed; leave copy space above.
Faint distant wind; no lettering, speech or extra action.
workflows.image_alt_zh: 山顶观测站中的虚构茶瓶，源库参考图
workflows.image_alt: Fictional tea bottle in a mountaintop observatory, source-library reference

workflows.name: Music and release teasers
workflows.output_zh: 动态封面、音乐预告视觉；适合音乐人和封面设计师。
workflows.output: Animated cover concepts and teaser visuals for musicians and cover designers.
workflows.reason_zh: 先做一段可配歌的视觉底片，歌曲节奏在剪辑时控制。
workflows.reason: Make a visual bed for a track first, then control musical timing in editing.
support: 需要不同产品或封面构图时选用
缺连接两段视觉的过渡镜头时选用
pickup: Add restrained illustrated or character motion
workflows.steps_zh: 先选自己有权使用的歌和一个视觉主题 → MusicMaker 试拍 → 检查后补同主题镜头 → 剪辑软件配歌、卡点与字幕。
workflows.steps: Choose a cleared track and one visual theme → trial in MusicMaker → inspect and add matching shots → time music and captions in an editor.
workflows.inputs_zh: 先试下方虚构音箱；换成自己的封面物件时，只替换外观描述。准备有权使用的歌曲供后期配乐。
workflows.inputs: Try the fictional speaker below; substitute your own cover object by changing its appearance description. Prepare a cleared track for the edit.
workflows.review_zh: 检查音箱轮廓和材质是否保持不变、绕拍是否平稳；歌名、字幕和节拍在剪辑时检查。
workflows.review: Check speaker silhouette, material stability and a steady orbit; verify titles, captions and beat timing in editing.
workflows.tags_zh: 音乐 · 预告视觉 · 后期配歌
workflows.lesson_zh: 源配方用音箱演示绕拍，并强调只借运镜、不复制参考内容。这里把它改成新歌预告的视觉底片：先用一小段平稳绕拍，再由剪辑配上自己的歌曲和标题。
workflows.lesson: The source speaker recipe borrows camera motion without copying reference content. Adapt it into a teaser background: make one restrained orbit, then add your own track and title in editing.
workflows.next_zh: 先留一秒静止音箱，再接小幅绕拍，最后停留并加入歌名和发布日期。把这三段导入剪辑软件，配自己的歌，在重拍处剪切。
workflows.next: Begin with a second of the still speaker, follow with the short orbit, then hold for a title and release date. Import these beats into an editor, add your own track and cut on its beats.
workflows.fix_zh: 绕拍时音箱变形，就先固定镜头，仅让光线变化；确认轮廓稳定后再加小幅运镜。
workflows.fix: If the orbit deforms the speaker, lock the camera and change only the light; add a small camera move after its shape holds.
workflows.homepage_prompt_zh:
生成一个 5 秒的 1:1 镜头，作为新歌预告视觉。
石墨灰与软木拼接的虚构便携音箱放在干净桌面上。
摄影机围绕静止音箱缓慢移动一个很小的角度，最后一秒停住。
音箱轮廓、按键数量和软木纹理不变，上方留白。
只保留室内环境声，不生成歌曲、歌词或文字。
workflows.homepage_prompt:
Create one five-second shot, 1:1, as a music teaser visual.
A fictional graphite-and-cork portable speaker rests on a clean desk.
Slowly orbit through a small angle around the still speaker; hold the last second.
Keep silhouette, button count and cork texture fixed; leave space above.
Room ambience only; no generated song, lyrics or text.
workflows.image_alt_zh: 石墨灰与软木便携音箱，源库参考图

workflows.name: Cinematic storyboards
workflows.output_zh: 开场、入场、运镜和转场预演；适合导演、摄影和广告分镜。
workflows.output: Opening, entrance, camera and transition studies for directors and storyboard artists.
workflows.reason_zh: 默认从 VideoWeb 的单镜头练习起步；VO4 是移动主体镜头的备选，不必两者都用。
workflows.reason: Start with the VideoWeb single-shot practice; VO4 is an alternative for a moving subject, not a required second stage.
support: 补分镜之间的过渡镜头
Generate a transition between storyboard beats
pickup: 需要跟随移动主体时选用
Use for a missing moving-subject tracking shot
workflows.steps_zh: VideoWeb 试拍一个明确起止的镜头 → 检查空间与运镜 → 同工具补必要镜头 → 剪辑排列分镜。
workflows.steps: Trial one shot with clear endpoints in VideoWeb → inspect space and camera path → add necessary shots in the same tool → arrange the storyboard in an editor.
workflows.inputs_zh: 先试下方运河，再把地点换成你的开场环境；始终写明镜头从哪里出发、停在哪里。
workflows.inputs: Try the canal below, then substitute your opening location. Always specify where the camera starts and stops.
workflows.review_zh: 检查桥体和岸线是否变形、前进方向是否一致、结尾是否能接下一镜。
workflows.review: Check bridge and bank geometry, consistent travel direction and a usable ending.
workflows.tags_zh: 分镜 · 运镜 · 首尾帧
workflows.lesson_zh: 源配方用雨后运河建立地点氛围。先取“沿岸推进到石桥”这一段：把镜头起点和终点写清楚，比同时要求多种运镜更容易检查空间是否稳定。
workflows.lesson: The source canal recipe establishes a place after rain. Keep one move along the bank toward the bridge: explicit start and end positions make spatial continuity easier to inspect than several camera moves at once.
workflows.next_zh: 先用运河镜头确定环境，再补桥边人物入场，最后停在人物将要走向的方向。统一摄影机高度和移动方向，剪成三格动态分镜。
workflows.next: Establish the canal, add a character entering beside the bridge, then hold toward their next destination. Keep camera height and screen direction consistent across the three storyboard shots.
workflows.fix_zh: 桥体弯曲或岸线跳动时，缩短推进距离；先不要再增加骑车人或转弯。
workflows.fix: If the bridge bends or the bank jumps, shorten the camera move before adding a cyclist or turn.
workflows.homepage_prompt_zh:
生成一个 5 秒的 16:9 镜头。
雨后清晨的虚构运河小镇，石桥在前方，一辆自行车静靠岸边。
摄影机保持人眼高度，沿岸缓慢向石桥推进，最后一秒停住。
石桥和岸线不变，自行车不动。轻微水声，不要切镜、对白或文字。
workflows.homepage_prompt:
Create one five-second shot, 16:9.
A fictional canal town after rain, with a stone bridge ahead and a parked bicycle on the bank.
At eye level, slowly push along the bank toward the bridge; hold the last second.
Keep the bridge and bank fixed, bicycle still. Soft water; no cuts, speech or text.
workflows.image_alt_zh: 雨后运河、石桥与停靠自行车，源库参考图
workflows.image_alt: Rain-washed canal, stone bridge and parked bicycle, source-library reference

workflows.name: Social character stories
workflows.output_zh: 角色反应与短剧概念；适合社交账号和短片创作者。
workflows.output: Character reactions and short-drama concepts for social and short-film creators.
workflows.reason_zh: 先完成一个角色的一次反应；偏插画风格时可改用 Fylia，避免同时换人物和画风。
workflows.reason: Start with one character reaction; use Fylia as an illustrated-style alternative, avoiding simultaneous identity and style changes.
support: 需要场景连接时生成过渡镜头
pickup: 补角色使用产品的动作
workflows.steps_zh: 自己先写三句故事 → SeeVido 试拍一个反应 → 检查角色一致性 → 同工具补前后镜头 → 剪辑；产品镜头按需加入。
workflows.steps: Write a three-sentence story yourself → trial one reaction in SeeVido → check identity continuity → add adjacent shots in the same tool → edit; add product inserts only if needed.
workflows.inputs_zh: 先试下方机器人；换人物时，固定外观、服装和场景，只改一次反应。跨镜头重复使用相同描述仍需检查一致性。
workflows.inputs: Try the robot below. For another character, fix identity, wardrobe and setting and change only one reaction. Repeated descriptions still require continuity checks.
workflows.review_zh: 脸、服装和手部是否变化，反应顺序是否清楚；对白另行完整听审。
workflows.review: Face, wardrobe and hands, clear reaction order, and a full listening check if dialogue is used.
workflows.tags_zh: 社交故事 · 角色反应 · 一致性
workflows.lesson_zh: 源配方让修理机器人发现、搬起并收好纽扣。先只拍“听见一声，转头发现”：故事的吸引力来自反应顺序，不必一次塞进完整剧情。
workflows.lesson: The source robot finds, lifts and stores a button. Start with “hear a ping, turn and notice”: the order of a reaction can tell a story without fitting the whole plot into one generation.
workflows.next_zh: 把纽扣落下作为开场，机器人转头作为主体，纽扣旁的停顿作为结尾。沿用同一套机器人外观和工作台描述，再考虑加入搬运动作。
workflows.next: Open with a button landing, use the head turn as the main reaction, then hold beside the button. Reuse the same robot and workshop description before adding a lifting action.
workflows.fix_zh: 把转头幅度改为“几乎不动，只轻微偏向纽扣”；若仍变形，先试角色静止的一镜，确认外观再加动作。
workflows.fix: Reduce the turn to “almost still, only a tiny tilt toward the button.” If identity still drifts, trial the character holding still before adding motion.
workflows.homepage_prompt_zh:
生成一个 5 秒的 9:16 黏土动画镜头。
木制微缩工作台上，一个芥末黄色方头机器人有黑色珠眼和蓝色工具袋。
听见一次轻微金属声后，它稍微转头看向旁边的珍珠色纽扣，停住。
固定中景，机器人外观和纽扣位置不变，不走路、不说话、不加文字。
workflows.homepage_prompt:
Create one five-second clay-animation shot, 9:16.
A mustard-yellow square-headed robot with black bead eyes and a blue pouch stands on a miniature wooden bench.
After one soft metallic ping, it turns its head slightly toward a pearl button and holds.
Fixed medium shot; unchanged identity and button position. No walking, speech or text.

workflows.name: Teaching and presentations
workflows.output_zh: 概念插图、教学场景和提案草稿；适合教师、产品经理及培训师。
workflows.output: Concept illustrations and presentation drafts for educators and product teams.
workflows.reason_zh: 用文字描述一个可见动作，先判断它是否帮助解释概念；这里使用的是视频入口，不是文本写作服务。
workflows.reason: Describe one visible action and test whether it clarifies a concept; this route is a video entry point, not a text-writing service.
support: 需要更明确的构图时试拍另一方案
补连接讲解步骤的过渡镜头
Add a transition between explanation steps
pickup: 缺空间展示或开场镜头时选用
Add a spatial reveal or opening shot
workflows.steps_zh: 先核对知识与讲解脚本 → Chat4o 试拍单个动作 → 检查事实和画面 → 补必要镜头 → 后期添加准确图注与解说。
workflows.steps: Verify the lesson and script → trial one action in Chat4o → check factual and visual accuracy → add needed shots → add accurate labels and narration in editing.
workflows.inputs_zh: 先试下方展台镜头；换成自己的课程时，一段只呈现一个已核实的讲解要点，图注与解说后期添加。
workflows.inputs: Try the exhibit below; for your own lesson, show one verified teaching point per shot and add labels and narration in editing.
workflows.review_zh: 知识是否正确、动作是否容易误解；把非实拍示意标为概念演示。
workflows.review: Factual accuracy and misleading motion; label conceptual illustrations as such.
workflows.tags_zh: 教学 · 概念演示 · 事实检查
workflows.lesson_zh: 源配方用一条轨道串起三个微缩生态环境。教学试拍先取其中一个展区，让观众看清“我要讲哪个区域”，具体知识再用准确图注和解说补充。 这个镜头只做课程开场，不承担科学解释；事实和因果要由有来源的讲解补充。
workflows.lesson: The source recipe links three miniature biomes by a rail. Start with one exhibit zone so viewers can see what the lesson concerns; add verified labels and narration afterwards. This is a lesson opener, not a scientific explanation; factual and causal claims need sourced narration.
workflows.next_zh: 先展示完整展台定位，再用缓慢推进强调森林区域，最后在静止画面上加图注。每段只讲一个要点，避免把微缩示意误当成真实生态过程。
workflows.next: Establish the model, push toward its forest zone, then add labels over the held frame. Explain one point per shot and distinguish the model from real ecological processes.
workflows.fix_zh: 展区边界变化时改为固定镜头；图注由人添加，不靠生成画面解释未经核实的因果关系。
workflows.fix: If exhibit boundaries move, lock the camera. Add labels manually and do not use generated motion to assert unverified causal relationships.
workflows.homepage_prompt_zh:
生成一个 5 秒的 16:9 教学概念镜头。
桌面微缩展台分为森林、沙地和湿地区域，一条小轨道贯穿其间。
从能看见完整展台的中景缓慢推进森林区域，最后一秒停留。
所有区域边界、轨道和植物位置固定，不增加物种。
轻微室内环境声，不生成文字、箭头或解说。
workflows.homepage_prompt:
Create one five-second educational concept shot, 16:9.
A tabletop exhibit has forest, sand and wetland zones connected by a small rail.
From a medium view of the whole model, slowly push toward the forest; hold the last second.
Keep zone boundaries, rail and plants fixed; add no species.
Soft room tone; no labels, arrows or narration.

workflows.image_alt: Museum tabletop rail connecting three miniature environments, source-library reference

workflows.name: Visual art and architecture
workflows.output_zh: 超现实场景、建筑氛围和光影试验；适合视觉与概念设计师。
workflows.output: Surreal scenes, architectural atmosphere and lighting studies for visual designers.
workflows.reason_zh: 先让一个局部发生变化，其余画面保持正常，便于判断创意是否成立。
workflows.reason: Change one small area while keeping the rest ordinary so the intended effect is easy to assess.
support: 需要插画风格时作为备选
pickup: 补连接两个空间的过渡镜头
workflows.steps_zh: SeaImagine 试拍一个空间变化 → 检查透视与反射 → 同工具补同风格镜头 → 剪辑；缺人物或移动镜头时再选备选。
workflows.steps: Trial one spatial change in SeaImagine → inspect perspective and reflections → add matching shots there → edit; use an alternative only for a missing character or moving shot.
workflows.inputs_zh: 先试下方虚构地图；改成建筑氛围时，可把抬起的纸脊换成掠过墙面的光影，仍只保留一个变化。
workflows.inputs: Try the fictional map below. For architecture, replace the rising ridge with a shadow crossing a wall, still keeping only one change.
workflows.review_zh: 检查纸张边缘和其余线条是否固定、只有指定区域抬起、纸张质感是否连贯。
workflows.review: Check fixed paper edges and surrounding lines, motion confined to the chosen area and continuous paper texture.
workflows.tags_zh: 视觉艺术 · 建筑 · 光影
workflows.lesson_zh: 源配方把平面地图变成立体景观。先只让一条等高线抬起：固定纸张边缘和其余线条，才能看清超现实变化究竟有没有按要求发生。
workflows.lesson: The source map becomes a miniature landscape. Lift only one contour first: fixed paper edges and surrounding lines make it clear whether the intended impossible change occurs.
workflows.next_zh: 先用平面地图建立正常状态，再接等高线抬起的主体镜头，最后停在立体轮廓。沿用俯拍角度和纸张纹理，后期排列成短循环草稿。
workflows.next: Establish the flat map, follow with the contour lift, then hold on the raised shape. Keep the overhead angle and paper texture consistent when arranging a short loop draft.
workflows.fix_zh: 整张地图融化时，限定只有中央一条线运动，并降低抬起幅度；先固定摄影机。
workflows.fix: If the whole map melts, restrict motion to one central line and reduce its lift. Keep the camera locked.
workflows.homepage_prompt_zh:
生成一个 5 秒的 16:9 超现实镜头。
固定俯拍：档案桌上一张米色纸质等高线地图。
只有中央一条等高线缓慢抬起成低矮纸脊，最后一秒停住。
纸张边缘和其余线条保持平面、位置不变，不裂开、不融化。
轻微纸张摩擦声，不增加文字或人物。
workflows.homepage_prompt:
Create one five-second surreal shot, 16:9.
Locked overhead view of a cream paper contour map on an archive desk.
Only one central contour slowly rises into a low paper ridge; hold the last second.
Keep paper edges and all other lines flat and fixed. No tearing or melting.
Soft paper friction; no added text or people.
workflows.image_alt_zh: 档案桌上的地图隆起成立体景观，源库参考图
workflows.image_alt: Archive map rising into a miniature landscape, source-library reference
